sources.supports: WebP lossy 25-34% smaller than JPEG at equal SSIM; lossless 26% smaller than PNG.
web.dev overview of the AVIF image format.
AVIF supported for about 96.3% of global users (Can I Use data updated 2026-10-22).
WebP supported for about 97.1% of global users (Can I Use data updated 2026-10-22).
The picture element lets the browser choose among source formats with an img fallback.
JPEG XL full support about 43% plus 17% partial (Can I Use data updated 2026-10-22).
Google Search supports BMP, GIF, JPEG, PNG, WebP, SVG and AVIF images.

AEOeye WebP vs AVIF encoding test (20 images, 2026-10-24) — the raw data behind the figures quoted in this decision page.

methodology: Figures come from AEOeye's own zero-cost measurements published under /resources: plain HTTP requests from a self-identified research user agent (AEOeyeResearch), robots.txt respected, 1 s between requests per domain; encoding tests run locally with cwebp/avifenc and SSIM via ffmpeg. Each dataset file states its exact method.
limitations: Convenience sample of well-known sites (not the whole web), homepages only, a single snapshot on 2026-10-24; the image test covers 20 screenshots, not photographs.
